claims.statement: A sum was posted with Harry Hill and John L. Sullivan was defied to cover it; the fragment does not name the depositor.
claims.excerpt: with Mr. Harry Hill and had defied Mr. 'Sullivan to cover that amount

claims.statement: Richard K. Fox's friends advised him to turn Allen adrift or take him out of the race.
claims.excerpt: Advieed by Ertends to Turn Atlen Adri or Take him ont of the Race.

notes: Garbled fragment; the subject of the deposit is unclear. The hints for an exhibition at Madison Square Garden (27 Nov 1882) and the 29 Nov dispute over the $1,000 are not in this text and were dropped. The Fox offer date is given as 9 Oct 1882 in 270.
